information.description:
The one on the crew who has seen it all and can still close a wound in a moving rig. Whether you reach the hospital is another matter.

REO Meatwagon: The cut-rate ambulance outfit the city pays to take the calls Trauma Team won't, in ground rigs older than their crews.

Stat block by Neon Hub. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
